gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 identifies that Euclidean-orthogonal coefficient columns do not produce weighted-orthogonal Chebyshev functions because T_0 has a different squared norm, and supplies the weighted-Gram repair.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The claimed functional orthogonality uses an unweighted coefficient orthogonality condition despite the nonuniform Chebyshev Gram matrix.

component_coverage.gold_component: Failure of the asserted weighted orthogonality of the functional factors due to unequal Chebyshev basis norms.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction gives the same weighted inner-product counterexample and explicitly proposes the Chebyshev Gram-matrix or weighted-QR correction.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-003 directly identifies the false O(mR) total-cost summary, distinguishes storage from arithmetic work, and names the omitted spline, DCT, SVD, and core costs with the corresponding repair.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The CP-aware RHOSVD method's total arithmetic cost is not O(mR); that figure applies only to a restricted storage component and omits established superlinear work terms.

component_coverage.gold_component: The remark incorrectly presents O(mR) as the method's total computational cost and omits the spline, DCT, side-matrix SVD, and Tucker-core work.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction states that the O(mR) claim covers neither the full stated procedure nor its additional costs, and its repair supplies the distinction and expanded work bound.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-006 identifies the invalid use of signed CP weights in a triangle-inequality upper bound, demonstrates a negative right-hand side, and gives the required absolute-value repair.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The proof treats signed xi_k as nonnegative factors outside absolute values; the bound must use |xi_k|.

component_coverage.gold_component: The lemma's first absolute-error bound and its triangle-inequality proof are invalid for signed CP weights.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction supplies the same signed-weight counterexample and explicitly replaces xi_k by |xi_k| in the bound and proof.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-011 identifies that constructing the trivariate spline from unrestricted n-by-n-by-n data requires full n^3-dependent work, contradicting the claimed O(m^3(m+n)) bound, and supplies the corrected accounting.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The one-dimensional spline estimate is incorrectly lifted to three dimensions by multiplying by m^3 without accounting for processing the full tensor input.

component_coverage.gold_component: The full-tensor trivariate spline-construction cost has understated n-dependence and should include O(n^3+m^3) in the isotropic case.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction gives the full-data processing diagnosis, explains why m^3 output samples do not suffice, and repairs the bound with O(n^3) spline construction.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-012 recognizes the boundary and cell-partition/indexing inconsistency, but does not recognize the distinct anisotropic volume-normalization error involving h^{-3} versus h_1h_2h_3. The full bundled gold concern is therefore incomplete.
